name: jev-codex-partner
description: Governed JEV evaluation through prompted external, potentially billable requests.

interface.shortDescription: Use governed JEV evaluations in Codex.
interface.longDescription: Adds a prompted TypeSafe JEV evaluator for bounded, advisory Boolean, Choice and Score judgements. Each use sends the approved payload to an external provider through Vercel AI Gateway and may be billable.
interface.defaultPrompt: Evaluate this bounded decision with JEV, show the typed probabilities and keep any consequential action subject to my approval.
